\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 246-249 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R254-first-pass-words-from-chapters-246-249}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for safety and a noise.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item foreign, English, Indian, golden, sky blue
  \item next, pale, steep, flattened, shiny
  \item a charger, a passport, a visa, a parcel, a magazine
  \item spice, cumin, coriander, mint, a cashew
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Foreign? (\textbf{\bn{বিদেশি}}, \emph{bideshi}.) English? (\textbf{\bn{ইংরেজি}}, \emph{ingreji}.) Indian? (\textbf{\bn{ভারতীয়}}, \emph{bhārôtīyô}.) Golden? (\textbf{\bn{সোনালি}}, \emph{sonāli}.) Sky blue? (\textbf{\bn{আকাশি}}, \emph{ākāshi}.) Next? (\textbf{\bn{পরের}}, \emph{pôrer}.) Pale? (\textbf{\bn{ফ্যাকাশে}}, \emph{phækāshe}.) Steep? (\textbf{\bn{খাড়া}}, \emph{khāṛā}.) Flattened? (\textbf{\bn{চ্যাপ্টা}}, \emph{chæpṭā}.) Shiny? (\textbf{\bn{চকচকে}}, \emph{chôkchôke}.) A charger? (\textbf{\bn{চার্জার}}, \emph{chārjār}.) A passport? (\textbf{\bn{পাসপোর্ট}}, \emph{pāsporṭ}.) A visa? (\textbf{\bn{ভিসা}}, \emph{bhisā}.) A parcel? (\textbf{\bn{পার্সেল}}, \emph{pārsel}.) A magazine? (\textbf{\bn{পত্রিকা}}, \emph{pôtrikā}.) Spice? (\textbf{\bn{মশলা}}, \emph{môshlā}.) Cumin? (\textbf{\bn{জিরে}}, \emph{jire}.) Coriander? (\textbf{\bn{ধনে}}, \emph{dhône}.) Mint? (\textbf{\bn{পুদিনা}}, \emph{pudinā}.) A cashew? (\textbf{\bn{কাজু}}, \emph{kāju}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 250-254 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R254-second-pass-words-from-chapters-250-254}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a crocodile and a giraffe.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a crocodile, a giraffe, a zebra, a spider, a kite
  \item a dance, an exhibition, a fair, a party, a journey
  \item a paternal aunt, a nephew, a grandson, a granddaughter, a father-in-law
  \item a lie, a mystery, a joke, a smile, friendship
  \item an election, an advantage, danger, safety, a noise
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A crocodile? (\textbf{\bn{কুমির}}, \emph{kumir}.) A giraffe? (\textbf{\bn{জিরাফ}}, \emph{jirāph}.) A zebra? (\textbf{\bn{জেব্রা}}, \emph{jebrā}.) A spider? (\textbf{\bn{মাকড়সা}}, \emph{mākôṛsā}.) A kite? (\textbf{\bn{চিল}}, \emph{chil}.) A dance? (\textbf{\bn{নাচ}}, \emph{nāch}.) An exhibition? (\textbf{\bn{প্রদর্শনী}}, \emph{prôdôrshônī}.) A fair? (\textbf{\bn{মেলা}}, \emph{melā}.) A party? (\textbf{\bn{পার্টি}}, \emph{pārṭi}.) A journey? (\textbf{\bn{যাত্রা}}, \emph{jātrā}.) A paternal aunt? (\textbf{\bn{কাকিমা}}, \emph{kākimā}.) A nephew? (\textbf{\bn{ভাইপো}}, \emph{bhāipo}.) A grandson? (\textbf{\bn{নাতি}}, \emph{nāti}.) A granddaughter? (\textbf{\bn{নাতনি}}, \emph{nātni}.) A father-in-law? (\textbf{\bn{শ্বশুর}}, \emph{shvôshur}.) A lie? (\textbf{\bn{মিথ্যে}}, \emph{mitthe}.) A mystery? (\textbf{\bn{রহস্য}}, \emph{rôhôsyô}.) A joke? (\textbf{\bn{রসিকতা}}, \emph{rôsikôtā}.) A smile? (\textbf{\bn{হাসি}}, \emph{hāsi}.) Friendship? (\textbf{\bn{বন্ধুত্ব}}, \emph{bôndhutvô}.) An election? (\textbf{\bn{নির্বাচন}}, \emph{nirbāchôn}.) An advantage? (\textbf{\bn{সুবিধা}}, \emph{subidhā}.) Danger? (\textbf{\bn{বিপদ}}, \emph{bipôd}.) Safety? (\textbf{\bn{নিরাপত্তা}}, \emph{nirāpôttā}.) A noise? (\textbf{\bn{আওয়াজ}}, \emph{āoyāj}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
